text.zh: 机器人
text.en: Robots

text.zh:
“ 机器人 ”“ 末端操纵装置 ” 和控制器：
说明：2B207 项不管制为诸如汽车喷漆台之类的非核工业应用而专门设计的 “ 机器人”。
技术说明：
1．在 2B207项中，“机器人”是指一种操纵机构，可以连续轨径作业或按点位作业 ， 还可能使用“传感器”并具有以下所有特性：
a．多功能；
b．通过在三维空间中的可变移动能够使材料、零件、工具或专用装置定位或定向；c ． 包含 3个或更多个可能装有步进电机的闭环或开环伺服装置；
d．通过教学、复演法或通过采用可编程序逻辑控制的电子计算机使该机有“用户可存取编程能力”，即无需机械干预。在上述定义中，“传感器”是指物理现象的探测器，其输出（在转换成一种可由控制器解释的信号之后）能够产生“程序”，或对“程序 ” 指令或数字“程序”数据进行修改。其包括具有机器显示、红外线成像、声像、触觉测量、惯性位置测量、光学或声学测距或力测量或转矩测量等能力的“传感器”。在上述定义中，
text.en: “Robots,” “end-effectors,” and controllers: Note: 2B207 does not control “robots” specially designed for non-nuclear industrial applications such as automobile paint booths. Technical Notes: 1. In 2B207, “robot” means a manipulation mechanism, capable of continuous-path or point-to-point operation, which may use “sensors” and has all of the following characteristics: a. Multifunctional; b. Capable of positioning or orienting materials, parts, tools, or special devices through variable movements in three-dimensional space; c. Incorporates three or more closed- or open-loop servo devices, which may include stepping motors; d. Has “user-accessible programmability” through teach/playback or an electronic computer with programmable logic control, without mechanical intervention. In the definition above, “sensor” means a detector of a physical phenomenon whose output, after conversion into a signal interpretable by a controller, can generate “programs” or modify “program” instructions or numerical “program” data. These include “sensors” with capabilities for machine vision, infrared imaging, acoustic imaging, tactile measurement, inertial position measurement, optical or acoustic ranging, or force or torque measurement. In the definition above,

text.zh:
“用户可存取编程能力”是指允许用户采用以下方法之外的方法插入、修改或替换“程序”的设施：
a．布线或互接上的实际变化；
b．包括输入参数在内的功能控制器的设定。在上述定义中，“机器人”不包括以下装置：
a．仅采用手动控制、遥控的操纵机构；
b．固定顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定的程序运动的自动运转装置。通过固定的止动件（ 例如 ： 销或凸轮）机械地限制该“程序”。采用机械的、电子的或电气的手段不可能改变或变更运转顺序和选择轨径或角度；
c．机械式控制可变顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定的程序运动的自动运转装置。通过固定的、然而却是可调的止动件 （ 例如：销或凸轮）机械地限制该 “ 程序”。在固定的“程序”模式里，运转顺序和轨径或角度的选择是可以改变的。只有通过机械操作才能改变或修改（例如：更改所用销或调换凸轮）一个或多个运动轴上 “ 程序”模式；
d．非伺服控制可变顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定程序运动的自动运转装置。
text.en: “user-accessible programmability” means the facility allowing a user to insert, modify, or replace “programs” by means other than the following: a. Physical changes to wiring or interconnections; b. Setting function controls, including entering parameters. In this definition, “robots” do not include the following devices: a. Manipulation mechanisms controlled exclusively manually or by remote manual control; b. Fixed-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs. Mechanically limiting the “program” by fixed stops (e.g., pins or cams). The sequence of operations and choice of paths or angles cannot be changed by mechanical, electronic, or electrical means; c. Mechanically controlled variable-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs. Mechanically limiting the “program” by fixed but adjustable stops (e.g., pins or cams). The sequence of operations and choice of paths or angles can be varied within a fixed “program” pattern. The “program” pattern on one or more axes of motion can be changed or modified only through mechanical operations (e.g., changing pins or exchanging cams); d. Non-servo-controlled variable-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs.

text.zh:
该“程序”是可以改变的，但是只有通过机械式固定的二进制电气装置输出的二进制信号或可调的止动件才能使运动按顺序继续进行；
e．被定义为笛卡尔坐标操纵系统的塔式起重机，作为垂直排列贮存箱仓库的组成部分，用于存取箱中的内装物。
2．在 2B207项中，“末端操纵装置 ” 包括夹持器、“有源加工单元”以及附在“机器人”操纵臂末端主夹板上的任何其他工具。在上述定义中，“有源加工单元”是指一种对工件施加动力源、过程能量或对其进行检测的装置。
a．具有以下任一特性的“机器人”或“末端操纵装置”：
1．按照国家安全标准专门设计，能用于处理高能炸药（例如：符合高能炸药电气法规标称值）；
2．专门设计或评定为抗辐射的，能经受大于 5×10⁴Gy（硅）的辐射而不会降低使用性能；
技术说明：Gy（硅）是指某一未屏蔽的硅样品暴露于电离辐射时所吸收的能量，以 J/kg 为单位。
text.en: The “program” can be changed, but the sequence proceeds only through binary signals output by mechanically fixed binary electrical devices or adjustable stops; e. Stacker cranes defined as Cartesian-coordinate manipulation systems, incorporated into warehouses with vertically arranged storage bins for accessing bin contents. 2. In 2B207, “end-effectors” include grippers, “active tooling units,” and any other tooling attached to the baseplate at the end of a “robot” manipulator arm. In this definition, an “active tooling unit” means a device that applies motive power or process energy to, or senses, a workpiece. a. “Robots” or “end-effectors” having either of the following characteristics: 1. Specially designed to comply with national safety standards for handling high explosives (e.g., meeting electrical-code ratings for high explosives); 2. Specially designed or rated as radiation-hardened to withstand radiation greater than 5×10⁴ Gy (silicon) without operational degradation; Technical Note: Gy (silicon) means the energy, in J/kg, absorbed by an unshielded silicon sample exposed to ionizing radiation.

text.zh:
“ 机器人 ”“ 末端操纵装置 ” 和控制器：
说明：2B207 项不管制为诸如汽车喷漆台之类的非核工业应用而专门设计的 “ 机器人”。
技术说明：
1．在 2B207项中，“机器人”是指一种操纵机构，可以连续轨径作业或按点位作业 ， 还可能使用“传感器”并具有以下所有特性：
a．多功能；
b．通过在三维空间中的可变移动能够使材料、零件、工具或专用装置定位或定向；c ． 包含 3个或更多个可能装有步进电机的闭环或开环伺服装置；
d．通过教学、复演法或通过采用可编程序逻辑控制的电子计算机使该机有“用户可存取编程能力”，即无需机械干预。在上述定义中，“传感器”是指物理现象的探测器，其输出（在转换成一种可由控制器解释的信号之后）能够产生“程序”，或对“程序 ” 指令或数字“程序”数据进行修改。其包括具有机器显示、红外线成像、声像、触觉测量、惯性位置测量、光学或声学测距或力测量或转矩测量等能力的“传感器”。在上述定义中，
text.en: “Robots,” “end-effectors,” and controllers: Note: 2B207 does not control “robots” specially designed for non-nuclear industrial applications such as automobile paint booths. Technical Notes: 1. In 2B207, “robot” means a manipulation mechanism, capable of continuous-path or point-to-point operation, which may use “sensors” and has all of the following characteristics: a. Multifunctional; b. Capable of positioning or orienting materials, parts, tools, or special devices through variable movements in three-dimensional space; c. Incorporates three or more closed- or open-loop servo devices, which may include stepping motors; d. Has “user-accessible programmability” through teach/playback or an electronic computer with programmable logic control, without mechanical intervention. In the definition above, “sensor” means a detector of a physical phenomenon whose output, after conversion into a signal interpretable by a controller, can generate “programs” or modify “program” instructions or numerical “program” data. These include “sensors” with capabilities for machine vision, infrared imaging, acoustic imaging, tactile measurement, inertial position measurement, optical or acoustic ranging, or force or torque measurement. In the definition above,

text.zh:
“用户可存取编程能力”是指允许用户采用以下方法之外的方法插入、修改或替换“程序”的设施：
a．布线或互接上的实际变化；
b．包括输入参数在内的功能控制器的设定。在上述定义中，“机器人”不包括以下装置：
a．仅采用手动控制、遥控的操纵机构；
b．固定顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定的程序运动的自动运转装置。通过固定的止动件（ 例如 ： 销或凸轮）机械地限制该“程序”。采用机械的、电子的或电气的手段不可能改变或变更运转顺序和选择轨径或角度；
c．机械式控制可变顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定的程序运动的自动运转装置。通过固定的、然而却是可调的止动件 （ 例如：销或凸轮）机械地限制该 “ 程序”。在固定的“程序”模式里，运转顺序和轨径或角度的选择是可以改变的。只有通过机械操作才能改变或修改（例如：更改所用销或调换凸轮）一个或多个运动轴上 “ 程序”模式；
d．非伺服控制可变顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定程序运动的自动运转装置。
text.en: “user-accessible programmability” means the facility allowing a user to insert, modify, or replace “programs” by means other than the following: a. Physical changes to wiring or interconnections; b. Setting function controls, including entering parameters. In this definition, “robots” do not include the following devices: a. Manipulation mechanisms controlled exclusively manually or by remote manual control; b. Fixed-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs. Mechanically limiting the “program” by fixed stops (e.g., pins or cams). The sequence of operations and choice of paths or angles cannot be changed by mechanical, electronic, or electrical means; c. Mechanically controlled variable-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs. Mechanically limiting the “program” by fixed but adjustable stops (e.g., pins or cams). The sequence of operations and choice of paths or angles can be varied within a fixed “program” pattern. The “program” pattern on one or more axes of motion can be changed or modified only through mechanical operations (e.g., changing pins or exchanging cams); d. Non-servo-controlled variable-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs.

text.zh:
该“程序”是可以改变的，但是只有通过机械式固定的二进制电气装置输出的二进制信号或可调的止动件才能使运动按顺序继续进行；
e．被定义为笛卡尔坐标操纵系统的塔式起重机，作为垂直排列贮存箱仓库的组成部分，用于存取箱中的内装物。
2．在 2B207项中，“末端操纵装置 ” 包括夹持器、“有源加工单元”以及附在“机器人”操纵臂末端主夹板上的任何其他工具。在上述定义中，“有源加工单元”是指一种对工件施加动力源、过程能量或对其进行检测的装置。
a．具有以下任一特性的“机器人”或“末端操纵装置”：
1．按照国家安全标准专门设计，能用于处理高能炸药（例如：符合高能炸药电气法规标称值）；
2．专门设计或评定为抗辐射的，能经受大于 5×10⁴Gy（硅）的辐射而不会降低使用性能；
技术说明：Gy（硅）是指某一未屏蔽的硅样品暴露于电离辐射时所吸收的能量，以 J/kg 为单位。
text.en: The “program” can be changed, but the sequence proceeds only through binary signals output by mechanically fixed binary electrical devices or adjustable stops; e. Stacker cranes defined as Cartesian-coordinate manipulation systems, incorporated into warehouses with vertically arranged storage bins for accessing bin contents. 2. In 2B207, “end-effectors” include grippers, “active tooling units,” and any other tooling attached to the baseplate at the end of a “robot” manipulator arm. In this definition, an “active tooling unit” means a device that applies motive power or process energy to, or senses, a workpiece. a. “Robots” or “end-effectors” having either of the following characteristics: 1. Specially designed to comply with national safety standards for handling high explosives (e.g., meeting electrical-code ratings for high explosives); 2. Specially designed or rated as radiation-hardened to withstand radiation greater than 5×10⁴ Gy (silicon) without operational degradation; Technical Note: Gy (silicon) means the energy, in J/kg, absorbed by an unshielded silicon sample exposed to ionizing radiation.

summary.zh: 滚压成形机、能够具有滚压成形功能的旋压成形机
summary.en: Flow-forming machines and spin-forming machines capable of flow-forming functions

text.zh: 滚压成形机、能够具有滚压成形功能的旋压成形机
text.en: Flow-forming machines and spin-forming machines capable of flow-forming functions

text.zh:
滚压成形机、能够具有滚压成形功能的旋压成形机和芯轴：
a．具有以下两种特性的机器：
1．装有 3 个或 3 个以上滚轮（主动式或导向式）；
2．根据制造商的技术规格，可配备“数控”单元或计算机控制器；
说明：2B209.a 项管制只有一个用来使金属变形的滚轮和两个用以支撑芯轴但不直接参加变形过程的辅助滚轮的机器。
text.en: Flow-forming machines, spin-forming machines capable of flow forming, and mandrels: a. Machines having both of the following characteristics: 1. Equipped with three or more rollers (active or guiding); 2. Capable, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, of being equipped with "numerical control" units or computer controllers; Note: 2B209.a controls machines with only one roller used to deform metal and two auxiliary rollers that support the mandrel without directly participating in the deformation process.

a．具有以下所有特性的电动式振动试验系统：
1．使用反馈或闭环控制技术并包括“数控”单元；
2．能够在20～2000 Hz 频率范围内产生10 g₀ 均方根（RMS）或更大的振动；
3．能够施加50 kN 或更大的力（“空台”测量）；
text.en: Vibration test systems, equipment and components: Technical Note: "Bare table" means a platform or surface without fixtures or fittings. a. Capable of producing vibration of 10 g₀ root mean square (RMS) or greater over the frequency range of 20–2000 Hz; 3. Capable of applying a force of 50 kN or greater, measured with a “bare table”;

text.zh:
固定式或便携式、卧式或立式离心多面平衡机：

summary.zh: 压力传感器
summary.en: Pressure transducers

text.zh: 压力传感器
text.en: Pressure transducers

text.zh:
具有以下所有特性的所有类型的压力传感器：
技术说明：
1．2B230 项所管制的压力传感器是把压力测量结果转变为电可用信号的装置。
2．2B230 项所述 “ 精度 ” 包括常温下非线性度、滞后量和再现性。
a．由铝、铝合金、氧化铝（矾土或蓝宝石）、镍、镍含量大于等于 60%（按重量计）的镍合金或完全氟化的烃聚合物制造或保护的压力敏感元件；
b．如果有，压力敏感元件所需且直接接触过程介质的封装，该封装由铝、铝合金、氧化铝（矾土或蓝宝石）、镍、镍含量大于等于 60%（按重量计）的镍合金、完全氟化的烃聚合物制造或保护；
c．具有以下任一特性：
1．满量程小于 13 kPa、“精度”高于满量程±1%；
2．满量程大于等于 13 kPa、13 kPa 压力点测量“精度”高于±130 Pa。
text.en: Pressure transducers of all types having all of the following characteristics: Technical Notes: 1. Pressure transducers controlled under 2B230 are devices that convert pressure measurements into electrically usable signals. 2. "Accuracy" in 2B230 includes nonlinearity, hysteresis and repeatability at ambient temperature. a. Pressure-sensing elements made of or protected by aluminum, aluminum alloys, aluminum oxide (alumina or sapphire), nickel, nickel alloys containing 60% or more nickel by weight, or fully fluorinated hydrocarbon polymers; b. If present, the enclosure required for the pressure-sensing element and in direct contact with the process medium, made of or protected by aluminum, aluminum alloys, aluminum oxide (alumina or sapphire), nickel, nickel alloys containing 60% or more nickel by weight, or fully fluorinated hydrocarbon polymers; c. Having either of the following characteristics: 1. A full scale of less than 13 kPa and “accuracy” better than ±1% of full scale; 2. A full scale of 13 kPa or greater and measurement “accuracy” better than ±130 Pa at the 13 kPa pressure point.

1．在涡旋压缩机或涡旋真空泵中，一对或多对相互啮合的涡旋盘或涡盘中形成月牙形气室，相互啮合的涡旋盘一个运动而另外一个保持不动。运动的涡盘围绕不动的涡盘旋转摆动，而自身不旋转。随着动涡轮盘绕静涡轮盘的运动，转向机器出口端月牙形气室逐步缩小（即气体被压缩）。
2．在波纹管密封涡旋压缩机或真空泵中，工艺气体通过一个金属波纹管与泵的润滑部件和外部大气完全隔开。波纹管的一端连接到动涡盘，另一端连接到真空泵的壳体。
3．含氟聚合物包括但不限于以下材料：
a．聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）；
b．聚全氟乙丙烯（FEP）；
text.en: Bellows-sealed scroll compressors and bellows-sealed scroll vacuum pumps having all of the following characteristics: a. Capable of an inlet volumetric flow of 50 m³/h or greater; b. Capable of a compression ratio of 2:1 or greater; c. All surfaces in contact with the process gas are made of any of the following materials: 1. Aluminum or aluminum alloys; 2. Aluminum oxide; 3. Stainless steel; 4. Nickel or nickel alloys; 5. Phosphor bronze; 6. Fluoropolymers. Technical Notes: 1. In a scroll compressor or scroll vacuum pump, one or more pairs of intermeshing scrolls form crescent-shaped gas pockets, with one scroll moving and the other stationary. The moving scroll orbits the stationary scroll without rotating about its own axis. As the moving scroll orbits the stationary scroll, the crescent-shaped gas pockets progressively shrink toward the machine outlet, compressing the gas. 2. In a bellows-sealed scroll compressor or vacuum pump, a metal bellows completely isolates the process gas from the pump's lubricated parts and the outside atmosphere. One end of the bellows is attached to the moving scroll, and the other to the vacuum-pump housing. 3. Fluoropolymers include, but are not limited to, the following materials: a. Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE); b. Fluorinated ethylene propylene (FEP);

d．聚三氟氯乙烯（PCTFE）；
e．偏氟乙烯-六氟丙烯共聚物。

text.en: Complete containment facilities

text.zh:
生物材料处理设备：
a．符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（2004 年第三版，日内瓦）所规定的生物安全水平三级（BL-3）、四级（BL-4）标准的全密闭设施；
说明：
1．“生物安全水平三级（BL-3）”是指生物医学或微生物学实验室，使用高效空气粒子过滤器（HEPA），在对外环境保持负压、人员和物品出入实行控制、废水废气废物处理，以及微生物操作规程、个人防护等方面，符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（2004 年第三版，日内瓦）所规定的生物安全三级标准的实验室封闭水平和生物安全处理能力。
2．“生物安全水平四级（BL-4）”是指生物医学或微生物学实验室，使用高效空气粒子过滤器（HEPA），在对外环境保持负压、人员和物品出入实行控制、废水废气废物处理，以及微生物操作规程、个人防护等方面，符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（2004 年第三版，日内瓦）所规定的生物安全四级标准的实验室封闭水平和生物安全处理能力。
text.en: Biological material processing equipment: a. Complete containment facilities meeting biosafety level 3 (BL-3) or level 4 (BL-4) criteria in the World Health Organization's Laboratory Biosafety Manual, third edition, Geneva, 2004; Notes: 1. “Biosafety Level 3 (BL-3)” means the laboratory containment level and biosafety handling capability of a biomedical or microbiological laboratory using high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters, maintaining negative pressure relative to the outside environment, controlling entry and exit of personnel and materials, treating wastewater, exhaust gases, and waste, and meeting the Level 3 standards for microbiological practices and personal protection specified in the World Health Organization’s Laboratory Biosafety Manual (3rd edition, Geneva, 2004). 2. “Biosafety Level 4 (BL-4)” means the laboratory containment level and biosafety handling capability of a biomedical or microbiological laboratory using high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters, maintaining negative pressure relative to the outside environment, controlling entry and exit of personnel and materials, treating wastewater, exhaust gases, and waste, and meeting the Level 4 standards for microbiological practices and personal protection specified in the World Health Organization’s Laboratory Biosafety Manual (3rd edition, Geneva, 2004).

text.zh: 其特点是在生物安全水平三级的基础上，通过增加气密系统、分隔通道系统，使用三级生物安全柜或正压工作服，以及专用的空气控制系统等，以达到比生物安全水平三级更严密的生物封闭和更高的生物安全处理能力。
text.en: It builds on biosafety level 3 by adding airtight systems, segregated access systems, class III biological safety cabinets or positive-pressure suits, and dedicated air-control systems to achieve tighter biological containment and greater biosafety-handling capability than level 3.

说明：2B352.d项不管制由制造商标明的反向渗透设备。
1．具有以下所有特性，不泄漏气溶胶，可用于分离 “ 病原微生物 ”“ 毒素 ”和细胞培养物的交叉流（切向流）过滤设备：
a．总过滤面积大于等于 1 m²；
b．可原位灭菌或消毒；技术说明 ：2B352.d.1.b 项所述的“灭菌”是指通过使用物理（蒸汽）或化学剂杀灭设备中所有的活微生物 ；“消毒”是指通过使用具有杀菌作用的化学剂，破坏设备中微生物的潜在感染力。“消毒”和“灭菌”不同于“卫生处理”，“卫生处理”是指用于降低设备中微生物含量而不必达到消灭所有微生物感染力或存活力的清洁过程。
text.en: Biological material processing equipment: d. Cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration equipment and components: Note: 2B352.d does not control equipment identified by its manufacturer as reverse-osmosis equipment. 1. Cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration equipment that does not release aerosols, usable for separating “pathogenic microorganisms,” “toxins,” and cell cultures, having all of the following characteristics: a. A total filtration area of 1 m² or greater; b. Capable of in-situ sterilization or disinfection; Technical Note: In 2B352.d.1.b, “sterilization” means killing all viable microorganisms in equipment through physical means (steam) or chemical agents; “Disinfection” means destroying the potential infectivity of microorganisms in the equipment using germicidal chemicals. “Disinfection” and “sterilization” differ from “sanitization,” a cleaning process that reduces microbial content in equipment without necessarily eliminating all microbial infectivity or viability.

text.zh:
生物材料处理设备：
h．喷雾或雾化系统及其组件：
技术说明：
1．“轻于航空器的飞行器”是指依赖热气或轻于空气的气体（例如：氦气或氢气）升空的气球和飞船。

4．对专门设计用于飞行器或“无人驾驶航空器”上的喷雾设备或喷嘴所形成的液滴大小，应当使用多普勒激光法或前置激光衍射法测量。
1．专门设计或改进后可安装在轻于航空器的飞行器或“无人驾驶航空器”上的全套喷雾或雾化系统，能够将干粉颗粒以每分钟大于 2 L 的流量播散为体积中值直径（VMD）小于 50 μm 的初始液滴；
text.en: Biological material processing equipment: h. Spraying or fogging systems and components: Technical Notes: 1. “Lighter-than-air vehicles” means balloons and airships that obtain lift from hot air or lighter-than-air gases, such as helium or hydrogen. 2. "Aerosol generators" means equipment specially designed or modified for installation on aircraft, such as nozzles, rotary atomizers and similar devices. 3. 2B352.h does not control spraying or fogging systems and their components that are incapable of disseminating biological agents as infectious aerosols. 4. Droplet size produced by spraying equipment or nozzles specially designed for aircraft or “unmanned aerial vehicles” shall be measured using laser Doppler or forward laser diffraction methods. 1. Complete spraying or fogging systems specially designed or modified for installation on lighter-than-aircraft vehicles [source wording; likely lighter-than-air vehicles] or “unmanned aerial vehicles,” capable of disseminating dry-powder particles as initial droplets with a volume median diameter (VMD) below 50 μm at flow rates greater than 2 L per minute;

Droplet size produced by spraying equipment or nozzles specially designed for aircraft or “unmanned aerial vehicles” shall be measured using laser Doppler or forward laser diffraction methods. 3. text.zh: 模/数转换器
text.en: Analog-to-digital converters

text.zh:
具有以下任一特性的模 / 数转换器：
a．在-54～125℃的温度范围内连续工作；
b．专门设计以符合加固设备的军用技术规范；
c．专门设计或改进成军用，或设计成抗辐射的，并具有以下任一特性：
1．在额定“精度”下转换速率大于每秒200000 次完整的转换；
2．在规定的工作温度范围内 “ 精度 ” 超过满量程的 1/10000以上；
3．品质因数为 1×10⁸以上（每秒转换次数除以“精度”）；
4．内含具有以下两种特性的模数转换器微型电路：
a．达到最大分辨率时的最长转换时间小于 20 μs；
b．在规定的工作温度范围内，额定的非线性度高于满量程的 0.025%。
text.en: Analog-to-digital converters having any of the following characteristics: a. Continuous operation over the temperature range of -54 to 125 °C; b. Specially designed to meet military specifications for ruggedized equipment; c. Specially designed or modified for military use, or designed to be radiation-hardened, and having any of the following characteristics: 1. A conversion rate greater than 200000 complete conversions per second at rated “accuracy”; 2. “Accuracy” better than 1/10000 of full scale over the specified operating temperature range; 3. A figure of merit of 1×10⁸ or greater (conversions per second divided by “accuracy”); 4. Incorporating analog-to-digital converter microcircuits having both of the following characteristics: a. A maximum conversion time below 20 μs at maximum resolution; b. Rated nonlinearity better than 0.025% of full scale over the specified operating temperature range.

text.en: Capacitors, electromagnets, and accelerators: c. text.zh: 频率变换器或发电机
text.en: Frequency changers or generators

text.zh:
具有以下所有特性，可作为变频或固定频率电机驱动装置使用的频率变换器或发电机：注意 1：为气体离心过程专门设计或配备的变频器和发电机按照《中华人民共和国核出口管制清单》加以管制。注意 2：为增强或发挥频率变化器或发电机的性能以符合以下特性而专门设计的软件受 3D224 和 3D225 项管制。
a．提供 40 VA 或更高功率的多相输出；
b．在大于等于 600 Hz 的频率范围内工作；
c．频率控制优于 0.2%。
说明：
1．如果用于特定工业机械或消费品（机床、车辆等）的频率变换器符合上述特性，且可被拆卸、移作他用，则需按 3A225 项加以管制。
2．需综合考虑硬件及软件情况，判定频率变换器是否符合上述特性。
技术说明：
1．3A225 项所管制的频率变换器亦是通常所称的变频器或逆变器。
2．市场上其他设备，可能符合 3A225 项所述特性，
text.en: Frequency changers or generators usable as variable-frequency or fixed-frequency motor drives and having all of the following characteristics: Attention 1: Frequency changers and generators specially designed or prepared for gas-centrifuge processes are controlled under the Nuclear Export Control List of the People's Republic of China. Attention 2: Software specially designed to enhance or release the performance of frequency changers or generators so that they meet the following characteristics is controlled by 3D224 and 3D225. a. Multiphase output supplying 40 VA or more; b. Operation at frequencies of 600 Hz or greater; c. Frequency control better than 0.2%. Notes: 1. Frequency changers used for specific industrial machinery or consumer products (machine tools, vehicles, etc.) that meet the characteristics above and can be removed and repurposed are controlled by 3A225. 2. Both hardware and software must be considered when determining whether a frequency converter meets the above characteristics. Technical Notes: 1. Frequency converters controlled under 3A225 are also commonly called frequency inverters or inverters. 2. Other commercially available equipment may meet the characteristics described in 3A225,

text.zh: 例如发电机、电子测试设备、交流电源、变速电机驱动装置、变速驱动装置（VSD）、变频驱动装置（VFD）、可调频率驱动装置（AFD）或可调速驱动装置（ASD）等。
text.en: including generators, electronic test equipment, AC power supplies, variable-speed motor drives, variable-speed drives (VSDs), variable-frequency drives (VFDs), adjustable-frequency drives (AFDs), or adjustable-speed drives (ASDs).

title.zh: 高速脉冲发生器及其脉冲头
title.en: High-speed pulse generators and their pulse heads

summary.zh: 高速脉冲发生器及其脉冲头
summary.en: High-speed pulse generators and their pulse heads

text.zh: 高速脉冲发生器及其脉冲头
text.en: High-speed pulse generators and their pulse heads

text.zh:
具有以下两种特性的高速脉冲发生器及其“脉冲头”：
a．在小于 55 Ω电阻负载上的输出电压大于 6 V；
b．“脉冲转换时间”小于 500 ps。
技术说明：
1．在 3A230.b 项中，“脉冲转换时间”是指电压幅度从 10%增至 90%时的时间间隔。
2．“脉冲头”是指为接受电压阶跃函数并使之形成可包括矩形脉冲、三角形脉冲、阶跃脉冲、冲击脉冲、指数脉冲或单周期脉冲等各类脉冲形式而设计的脉冲形成网络。“脉冲头”可以是脉冲发生器的一个整体组成部分或该装置的一个插件模块，也可以是一个外部连接装置。
text.en: High-speed pulse generators and their “pulse heads,” having both of the following characteristics: a. An output voltage greater than 6 V into a resistive load below 55 Ω; b. A "pulse transition time" of less than 500 ps. Technical Notes: 1. In 3A230.b, “pulse transition time” means the interval during which the voltage amplitude rises from 10% to 90%. 2. “Pulse heads” means pulse-forming networks designed to accept a voltage step function and shape it into various pulse forms, including rectangular, triangular, step, impulse, exponential, or monocycle pulses. A “pulse head” may be an integral component of a pulse generator, a plug-in module, or an externally connected device.

雷管和多点起爆系统：
说明：3A232 项不管制仅使用起爆药（例如：叠氮化铅）的雷管。
技术说明：3A232项所管制的雷管均利用一个小导电体（例如：桥、桥丝或箔），当上升时间短的大电流电脉冲通过上述导电体时，使它爆炸而汽化。在非冲击片型雷管里，爆炸的导电体引起相接触的高能炸药如太安（PETN，季戊四醇四硝酸酯）化学爆轰。在冲击片型雷管里，导电体的爆炸蒸汽驱动飞片或冲击片飞过一个间隙，撞击炸药而引起化学爆轰 。 在某些设计中，冲击片是由磁力驱动。术语爆炸箔雷管，可以指爆炸桥雷管，或指冲击片型雷管。起爆器有时也被用来代替雷管。
a．电驱动的炸药雷管：
1．爆炸桥（EB）；
text.en: Detonators and multipoint initiation systems: Note: 3A232 does not control detonators using only primary explosives, such as lead azide. Technical Note: All detonators controlled by 3A232 use a small electrical conductor, such as a bridge, bridgewire or foil, which explosively vaporizes when a high-current electrical pulse with a short rise time passes through it. In nonslapper detonators, the exploding conductor initiates chemical detonation in a high explosive in contact with it, such as PETN (pentaerythritol tetranitrate). In slapper-type detonators, the explosive vaporization of a conductor propels a flyer or slapper across a gap to strike the explosive and initiate chemical detonation. In some designs, the slapper is magnetically driven. The term exploding-foil detonator may refer to an exploding-bridge detonator or a slapper-type detonator. The term initiator is sometimes used instead of detonator. a. Electrically driven explosive detonators: 1. Exploding bridge (EB);

text.zh:

d．具有以下两种特性的电子轰击质谱仪：
1．分子束入口系统，将准直的分析物分子束注入分子被电子束电离的离子源区域；
2．能冷却至-80 ℃或更低的温度，以捕获未被电子束电离的分析物分子的一个或多个“冷阱”；
技术说明：
1．3A233.d 项所管制的是通常用于六氟化铀气体样品同位素分析的质谱仪。
2．3A233.d 项所管制的电子轰击质谱仪也称电子冲击质谱仪或电子电离质谱仪。
3．在 3A233.d.2 项中，“冷阱”是一种通过将气体分子凝结或冻结在冷的表面上来捕集气体分子的装置。就本项而言，闭环气态氦低温真空泵不是“冷阱”。
text.en: Mass spectrometers capable of measuring ions of 230 u or greater, with a resolution better than 2/230, and their ion sources: N.B.: Mass spectrometers specially designed or manufactured for analyzing on-line uranium-hexafluoride samples are controlled under the Nuclear Export Control List of the People's Republic of China. d. Electron-bombardment mass spectrometers having both of the following characteristics: 1. A molecular-beam inlet system that injects a collimated beam of analyte molecules into the ion-source region where an electron beam ionizes the molecules; 2. One or more “cold traps” capable of cooling to -80 °C or lower to trap analyte molecules not ionized by the electron beam; Technical Notes: 1. 3A233.d controls mass spectrometers typically used for isotope analysis of uranium-hexafluoride gas samples. 2. Electron-bombardment mass spectrometers controlled under 3A233.d are also called electron-impact or electron-ionization mass spectrometers. 3. In 3A233.d.2, a “cold trap” is a device that captures gas molecules by condensing or freezing them on a cold surface. For this item, a closed-loop gaseous-helium cryogenic vacuum pump is not a “cold trap.”
